description: Customer parcel-tracking page in Portuguese and English for Project Atlas.
readme_text:
# atlas-tracking-page

A simple parcel-tracking page for **Project Atlas** customers in Lisbon and Porto. Owner: **Priya Natarajan**.

Retailers interviewed by **Daniel Okafor** asked for tracking links in Portuguese and English that show where a parcel is and when it will arrive. This repository holds the page design and a small mock data set.

Planned for the March 2027 soft launch.
